title: A Frequency-Aware Texture-Structure Fusion Network for RemoteSensing Image Super-Resolution
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: A Frequency-Aware Texture-Structure Fusion Network for RemoteSensing Image Super-Resolution
detail.abstract: Remote sensing image super-resolution (SR) aims to reconstruct high-resolution images with fine details and structural information from low-resolution observations. Deep-learning-based methods have achieved remarkable progress, but recovering high-frequency textures while preserving global structural consistency remains challenging. To address this problem, we propose a frequency-aware dual-branch super-resolution network (TSF-Net) that separately learns high-frequency and lowfrequency representations and integrates them through a feature fusion mechanism. Experimental results on the Aerial Image Dataset (AID) show that the proposed method achieves a PSNR of 29.7985 dB and an SSIM of 0.7866 on the AID dataset for the ×4 super-resolution task. Furthermore, frequency-domain analysis shows that the high-frequency branch increases the high-frequency energy ratio from 3.51% in the low-resolution input to 8.55%, while the low-frequency branch preserves low-frequency information with only 2.07% high-frequency energy. These results indicate that the proposed dual-branch architecture learns complementary frequency representations, leading to better reconstruction of both local textures and global structures. Overall, the proposed frequencyaware feature decomposition strategy provides an effective solution for remote sensing image superresolution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种频率感知双分支超分辨率网络（TSF-Net），通过分离学习高频和低频表示并融合，有效提升了遥感图像超分辨率重建的质量。
AI.research_question: 如何解决遥感图像超分辨率中高频纹理恢复与全局结构一致性保持之间的平衡问题？
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习方法虽取得进展，但在恢复高频细节的同时保持全局结构一致性仍具挑战性。
AI.theoretical_framework: 频率分解理论、双分支网络架构、特征融合机制。
AI.method: 提出TSF-Net，包含高频分支（学习高频纹理细节）和低频分支（保持低频全局结构），并通过特征融合机制整合两部分信息。
AI.findings: 在AID数据集×4超分任务上，PSNR达29.7985 dB，SSIM达0.7866；高频分支将高频能量比从3.51%提升至8.55%，低频分支仅含2.07%高频能量，验证了双分支的互补学习效果。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了频率感知的特征分解策略，证明了分离学习高低频表示对超分辨率重建的有效性，为遥感图像SR提供了新的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一种有效的遥感图像超分辨率解决方案，能够同时提升局部纹理细节和全局结构一致性，适用于遥感图像分析等实际应用场景。

title: Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in Industrial Surface Inspection
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Self-Supervised Contrastive Learning for Unsupervised Anomaly Detection in Industrial Surface Inspection
detail.abstract: Unsupervised anomaly detection in industrial surface inspection remains a critical challenge due to the scarcity of defective samples and the diversity of anomaly patterns. Existing methods predominantly rely on pre-trained ImageNet features or reconstruction-based approaches, which often fail to capture domain-specific representations essential for detecting subtle surface defects. To address this limitation, we propose a novel self-supervised contrastive learning framework, termed Contrastive Patch Learning (CPL), specifically designed for industrial anomaly detection. CPL leverages carefully designed data augmentation strategies tailored for surface textures, including geometric transformations, color jittering, and synthetic defect simulation, to construct positive and negative sample pairs. A dual-encoder architecture with momentum update is employed to learn robust, domain-specific feature representations from normal samples only. Furthermore, we introduce a patch-level contrastive objective that enforces local consistency while preserving global structural information, enabling fine-grained anomaly localization. Extensive experiments on the widely adopted MVTec AD benchmark demonstrate that CPL achieves competitive performance, with an image-level AUROC of 98.7% and pixel-level AUROC of 97.3%, outperforming several state-of-the-art methods including CutPaste and CS-Flow. Ablation studies validate the effectiveness of each component, and cross-dataset evaluation on the VisA dataset confirms the generalization capability of the proposed approach. The results indicate that self-supervised contrastive pre-training on domain-specific normal data significantly enhances anomaly detection performance compared to generic pre-trained features.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种名为对比补丁学习（CPL）的自监督对比学习框架，专用于工业表面异常检测。该方法通过精心设计的数据增强策略、双编码器动量更新架构和补丁级对比目标，仅从正常样本中学习领域特定的鲁棒特征表示，在MVTec AD和VisA数据集上取得了优异的异常检测与定位性能。
AI.research_question: 如何通过自监督对比学习在仅有正常样本的情况下，有效检测工业表面检测中多样化的细微缺陷？
AI.motivation: 现有方法依赖预训练ImageNet特征或基于重构的方法，难以捕获检测细微表面缺陷所需的领域特定表示，而已标注缺陷样本稀缺且异常模式多样化。
AI.theoretical_framework: 自监督对比学习、动量对比学习、补丁级对比学习
AI.method: 提出了对比补丁学习（CPL）框架，包括：为表面纹理设计的数据增强策略（几何变换、颜色抖动、合成缺陷模拟），双编码器架构（含动量更新），以及补丁级对比目标函数以强制局部一致性并保留全局结构信息。
AI.findings: 在MVTec AD基准上，图像级AUROC达98.7%，像素级AUROC达97.3%，优于CutPaste和CS-Flow等方法；消融实验验证了各组件的有效性；跨数据集VisA评估证实了方法的泛化能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了专门针对工业异常检测的自监督对比学习框架，证明了在领域特定正常数据上进行自监督对比预训练能显著优于使用通用预训练特征的方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为工业表面缺陷检测提供了一种仅需正常样本即可实现高精度检测与定位的实用方法，具有良好的泛化能力，可降低对大量标注缺陷样本的依赖。

title: Currency Markets on Liberation Day: Exchange Rate Responses to the 2025 US Tariff Shock
affiliations: Wilfrid Laurier University - School of Business & Economics and Arizona State University (ASU) - Economics Department

detail.title: Currency Markets on Liberation Day: Exchange Rate Responses to the 2025 US Tariff Shock
detail.abstract: We study how foreign exchange markets responded to the US “Liberation Day” tariff announcement of 2 April 2025. Using a near-global sample of 139 currencies, our event study shows that every exchange-rate regime group appreciated against the US dollar: floats by 2.04%, managed floats by 1.27%, and hard pegs by 2.84%. The exchange-rate regime and the level of tariffs are important drivers of the appreciation of target-country exchange rates, along with distance from the US, having a freetrade agreement with the US, and the share of a country’s imports sourced from the US.

AI.tldr: 本研究分析了2025年4月2日美国“解放日”关税公告对全球外汇市场的影响。基于139种货币的样本，事件研究发现所有汇率制度组别的货币均对美元升值：浮动汇率升值2.04%，管理浮动升值1.27%，硬钉住升值2.84%。汇率制度、关税水平、与美国的地理距离、是否与美国有自由贸易协定以及从美国进口的份额，都是目标国汇率升值的重要驱动因素。
AI.research_question: 美国“解放日”关税公告如何影响全球外汇市场？哪些因素驱动了目标国货币对美元的升值？
AI.motivation: 2025年4月2日美国宣布“解放日”关税，这是一次重大的贸易政策冲击。研究外汇市场对此事件的反应，有助于理解关税政策如何通过汇率渠道传导至全球经济。
AI.theoretical_framework: 事件研究法；汇率制度分类理论；国际贸易与汇率决定理论
AI.method: 事件研究法，样本涵盖全球139种货币，按汇率制度（浮动、管理浮动、硬钉住）分组分析，并考察关税水平、地理距离、自由贸易协定、进口份额等因素的影响。
AI.findings: 1）所有汇率制度组的货币均对美元升值，其中硬钉住升值最大（2.84%），浮动次之（2.04%），管理浮动最小（1.27%）；2）汇率制度、关税水平、与美国的地理距离、是否签订自由贸易协定、从美国进口的份额是汇率升值的重要驱动因素。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富了关税政策冲击对汇率传导机制的理解，为汇率制度在应对外部贸易政策冲击中的作用提供了实证证据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和市场参与者提供了关税公告对汇率影响的量化估计，有助于理解不同汇率制度国家在面对美国贸易政策冲击时的汇率表现差异。

title: ZSEVER: A Novel Pre-Disaster Evacuation Framework for Multi-Hazard Himalayan Terrain
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN and Indian Institute of Information Technology

detail.title: ZSEVER: A Novel Pre-Disaster Evacuation Framework for Multi-Hazard Himalayan Terrain
detail.abstract: Himalayan states in India face compound multi-hazard threats in every monsoon that standard evacuation frameworks cannot address. Existing models assume dense road connectivity, flat terrain, and settled resident-only populations, assumptions that fail catastrophically in mountain terrain, where a single landslide can sever the only valley egress route within fifteen minutes, while millions of transient pilgrims occupy the most vulnerable corridors. This paper introduces ZSEVER (Zone-Segregated Evacuation with Vertical Emergency Refuges), a simulation-validated disaster evacuation framework built on four main contributions: dual-mode routing combining horizontal road evacuation with vertical ridge-refuge pathways, second staggered time-window departure assignments preventing catastrophic convergence on single-lane valley roads, third a Dynamic Rerouting Engine (DRE) recomputing evacuation paths as road segments are incrementally removed, and forth a convoy-based movement protocol for transient pilgrim populations. The framework is grounded in a time-expanded multi-commodity flow formulation with refuge-altitude constraints. Validation through agent-based simulation (Python Mesa) parameterized on a synthetic Mandakini valley network, with Monte Carlo analysis across 100 scenario iterations, demonstrates that ZSEVER achieves 88.6% agent survival compared to 71.8% for road-only pre-disaster evacuation and 31.4% for reactive response. The vertical refuge pathway rescues 18.4% of the population whose road egress is severed by early closures. A critical two-hour warning threshold is identified below which vertical refuges become operationally indispensable.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ZSEVER框架，针对喜马拉雅山区多灾种威胁，结合水平道路疏散与垂直山脊避难路径，通过代理模拟验证，将生存率从71.8%（仅道路疏散）提升至88.6%。
AI.research_question: 如何为喜马拉雅山区（道路稀疏、地形陡峭、有大量 transient 朝圣者）设计有效的多灾种疏散框架？
AI.motivation: 现有疏散模型假设密集道路连接、平坦地形和仅常住人口，在山区完全失效（如一次滑坡15分钟内切断唯一山谷出口，数百万临时朝圣者占据脆弱走廊），亟需新框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 时间扩展多商品流模型（含避难所-海拔约束）、代理模拟（Python Mesa）、蒙特卡洛分析。
AI.method: 提出ZSEVER框架（分区疏散+垂直紧急避难所），含四种贡献：水平-垂直双模式路由、错峰时间窗出发、动态改道引擎（DRE）、车队移动协议。在合成Mandakini河谷网络上用Python Mesa进行代理模拟，100次蒙特卡洛迭代验证。
AI.findings: ZSEVER实现88.6%生存率（vs道路仅71.8% vs 被动反应31.4%）；垂直避难路径拯救了18.4%因早期道路关闭而无法撤离的人口；存在两小时预警阈值，低于此阈值垂直避难所成为操作上不可或缺的手段。
AI.theory_contributions: 将垂直避难路径纳入疏散理论，提出山区情境下的时间扩展多商品流模型与避难所-海拔约束，为极端地形下的疏散优化提供理论基础。
AI.practical_contributions: 为喜马拉雅山区及其他类似地形地区提供可操作的疏散框架（ZSEVER），包括动态改道引擎、车队协议等具体工具，并识别关键预警时间阈值以指导应急决策。

title: Mitigating Directional Concentration and Fixed-Structure Bias in Large-Scale Multi-Objective Optimization via a Two-Stage Evolutionary Framework
affiliations: Wuhan University of Science and Technology, Wuhan University of Science and Technology, Wuhan University of Science and Technology, Wuhan University of Science and Technology and Anhui University

detail.title: Mitigating Directional Concentration and Fixed-Structure Bias in Large-Scale Multi-Objective Optimization via a Two-Stage Evolutionary Framework
detail.abstract: Large-scale multi-objective optimization problems (LSMOPs) remain challenging for existingenhanced-search evolutionary algorithms in high-dimensional decision spaces. In this line ofresearch, two recurring limitations remain insufficiently addressed: directional concentration in early-stage direction-guided sampling, where highly correlated search directions narrow decision-space overage; and fixed-structure bias in later-stage search, where fixed population structures cannot adapt exploration–exploitation allocation across evolutionary stages, resulting in inefficient search coordination. To address these issues, this paper proposes LMOEA-BD, a two-stage evolutionary framework for large-scale multi-objective optimization. In the first stage, a distribution-aware boundary–directional hybrid sampling strategy is developed to mitigate directional concentration by complementing conventional directional sampling with distribution-aware boundary-guided search. A fuzzy search mechanism is further incorporated to enrich candidate diversity and strengthen early exploration. In the second stage, an adaptive dual-population search strategy is introduced to alleviate fixed-structure bias. The population is dynamically partitioned into exploration and exploitation subpopulations according to the current population state, and an asymmetric interaction mechanism is designed to coordinate information exchange between them. In this mechanism, the exploitation subpopulation provides convergence guidance to exploration, while the exploration subpopulation supplies diverse high-quality candidates to exploitation. By coupling early-stage coverage expansion with late-stage coordinated search, LMOEA-BD improves the balance between preserving diversity and enhancing convergence. Experimental studies on the LSMOP benchmark suite show that the proposed framework is competitive with several state-of-the-art algorithms in terms of both convergence and diversity.

AI.tldr: 本文提出LMOEA-BD两阶段进化框架解决大规模多目标优化问题：第一阶段采用分布感知的边界-方向混合采样策略缓解方向集中，第二阶段采用自适应双种群搜索策略缓解固定结构偏差，实验表明在收敛性和多样性上具有竞争力。
AI.research_question: 如何设计一个两阶段进化框架，同时解决大规模多目标优化中早期方向集中和后期固定结构偏差两个问题？
AI.motivation: 现有增强搜索进化算法在大规模多目标优化中面临两个未充分解决的局限：早期方向引导采样的方向集中导致决策空间覆盖不足，以及后期固定种群结构无法自适应调节探索与利用的分配。
AI.theoretical_framework: 两阶段进化优化框架、分布感知的边界-方向混合采样、模糊搜索机制、自适应双种群搜索、非对称交互机制
AI.method: 第一阶段：分布感知边界-方向混合采样+模糊搜索机制；第二阶段：自适应双种群划分（探索子群与利用子群）+非对称信息交互机制
AI.findings: 在LSMOP基准测试集上，LMOEA-BD在收敛性和多样性方面均优于多种最先进算法。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了两阶段协同进化框架，分别针对早期方向集中和后期结构偏差两类问题设计了针对性策略，丰富了大规模多目标优化的方法论体系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为大规模多目标优化问题提供了更有效的求解方案，可应用于工程优化、资源调度等实际场景。

title: Impact of population structure on physical and digital financial inclusion: theory and evidence
affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: Impact of population structure on physical and digital financial inclusion: theory and evidence
detail.abstract: This study investigates the impact of population structure on physical and digital financial inclusion in 52 countries from 2004 to 2023 after controlling for available fiscal resources, economic growth, inflation, financial literacy, institutional quality and mobile phone penetration. The population structure examined are the total population, male, female, rural, urban and the working population as well as the labour force participation rate and population growth rate. The data are analysed using the two-stage least squares regression estimation with instrumental variables and lagged dependent variables. The findings reveal a significant positive relationship between the older population and the level of physical and digital financial inclusion. There is a negative relationship between the working population and the level of digital financial inclusion. Institutional quality increases digital financial inclusion for the older population. Strong institutional quality constrains digital financial inclusion in a rapidly growing population. Institutional quality, economic growth and tax revenue are significant determinants of physical financial inclusion while financial literacy is a positive determinant of both physical and digital financial inclusion.

AI.tldr: 本研究利用2004-2023年52个国家的面板数据，通过两阶段最小二乘法发现：老年人口比例与物理和数字金融包容性正相关，劳动人口与数字金融包容性负相关，制度质量对老年人口的数字金融包容有促进作用，但对快速增长的人口则有抑制作用。
AI.research_question: 人口结构（总人口、性别、城乡、劳动人口、劳动力参与率、人口增长率）如何影响物理金融包容性和数字金融包容性？
AI.motivation: 现有研究对人口结构与金融包容性（尤其是数字金融）之间的关系关注不足，而人口结构变化是影响金融服务需求和供给的重要因素。
AI.theoretical_framework: 人口结构理论、金融包容性理论、制度经济理论
AI.method: 使用52个国家2004-2023年的面板数据，采用两阶段最小二乘回归（2SLS）并引入工具变量和滞后因变量进行估计。
AI.findings: （1）老年人口与物理及数字金融包容性显著正相关；（2）劳动人口与数字金融包容性负相关；（3）制度质量提升老年人口的数字金融包容性；（4）强制度质量抑制快速增长人口的数字金融包容性；（5）制度质量、经济增长和税收收入是物理金融包容性的显著决定因素；（6）金融素养对两种金融包容性均有正向影响。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了人口结构（尤其是老年人口和劳动人口）对物理与数字金融包容性的差异化影响，并厘清了制度质量在不同人口结构背景下的调节作用。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者提供了针对不同人口结构群体制定差异化金融包容政策的依据，特别是关注老龄化和人口快速增长背景下的制度设计。

title: Co-Creating Sustainable Enterprises through Open Innovation: Strengthening Africa-Europe Collaboration in Technology-Enabled Entrepreneurship
affiliations: Zimbabwe Open University and Zimbabwe Open University

detail.title: Co-Creating Sustainable Enterprises through Open Innovation: Strengthening Africa-Europe Collaboration in Technology-Enabled Entrepreneurship
detail.abstract: Collaborative open innovation and technology-enabled entrepreneurship have emerged as pivotal drivers of sustainable development across Africa and Europe. Despite growing policy attention, limited empirical synthesis existed on how such partnerships translated into measurable business and social impact. This study aimed to analyse the mechanisms through which open innovation ecosystems enhanced entrepreneurial performance and inclusivity in cross-regional collaborations. Using qualitative content analysis of secondary data from peerreviewed research and policy reports, the study identified that digital co-creation significantly strengthened business agility, innovation diffusion and socioeconomic resilience. Findings revealed those enterprises engaging in Africa-Europe collaborative innovation frameworks achieved increased R&D productivity, market expansion and digital sustainability alignment. The paper concluded that integrating technology-enabled entrepreneurship within open innovation networks fostered systemic competitiveness and shared prosperity, provided that institutional, policy and digital capacity barriers were systematically addressed. .

AI.tldr: 本文研究了非洲与欧洲之间的协作式开放创新与技术驱动型创业如何推动可持续发展，发现数字共创显著提升了企业敏捷性、创新扩散和社会经济韧性，但需系统性解决制度、政策和数字能力障碍。
AI.research_question: 开放创新生态系统如何通过跨区域协作增强创业绩效和包容性？
AI.motivation: 尽管政策关注度日益增加，但关于非洲与欧洲之间的协作开放创新如何转化为可衡量的商业与社会影响的实证综合研究仍然不足。
AI.theoretical_framework: 开放创新理论、技术驱动型创业理论、可持续发展理论、跨区域协作生态系统框架
AI.method: 对同行评审研究及政策报告的二手数据进行定性内容分析
AI.findings: 参与非洲-欧洲协作创新框架的企业在研发生产力、市场扩张和数字可持续性一致性方面取得了显著提升；数字共创显著增强了企业敏捷性、创新扩散和社会经济韧性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了开放创新网络中技术驱动型创业如何促进系统性竞争力与共享繁荣的机制，补充了跨区域创新创业生态系统的理论框架。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和企业提供了实践指导：需系统性解决制度、政策和数字能力障碍，才能充分发挥开放创新网络对可持续发展的推动作用。

title: Do Macroprudential Policies Amplify Monetary Transmission? Evidence from Arab Economies and Exchange-Rate Regimes
affiliations: Arab Monetary Fund

detail.title: Do Macroprudential Policies Amplify Monetary Transmission? Evidence from Arab Economies and Exchange-Rate Regimes
detail.abstract: This paper investigates whether monetary and macroprudential policies operate as complements or substitutes in Arab economies and whether exchange-rate arrangements shape this relationship. Using an unbalanced panel of 12 Arab economies over 2010-2024 and a dynamic System GMM framework, we estimate the direct and interactive effects of monetary and macroprudential policies on economic growth and credit dynamics, accounting for potential endogeneity and dynamic persistence. The results indicate that monetary tightening exerts a statistically significant negative effect on growth, whereas macroprudential policy contributes positively to macroeconomic resilience. More importantly, the interaction between monetary and macroprudential policies is positive and statistically significant, suggesting that monetary policy effects on output are conditional on macroprudential policy intensity rather than purely structural differences in transmission. Quantitatively, the results indicate that greater macroprudential policy intensity attenuates the adverse effect of monetary tightening on output, although the magnitude varies across institutional environments. The interaction effect is stronger in fixed exchange-rate regimes, consistent with the view that macroprudential instruments play a more prominent stabilization role when monetary-policy autonomy is constrained. Additional evidence from credit-growth regressions indicates that coordinated policy actions effectively restrain excessive credit expansion, supporting the credit-channel mechanism. The findings are consistent with the view that institutional arrangements shape the effectiveness of macro-financial policy interactions.

AI.tldr: 本研究基于2010-2024年12个阿拉伯经济体的面板数据，采用动态系统GMM方法，探讨货币政策和宏观审慎政策是互补还是替代关系，以及汇率制度如何影响这一关系。结果发现货币政策与宏观审慎政策存在互补效应，特别是在固定汇率制下，宏观审慎政策能有效缓解货币紧缩对经济增长的负面影响。
AI.research_question: 货币政策和宏观审慎政策在阿拉伯经济体中究竟是互补关系还是替代关系？汇率制度如何塑造这一关系？
AI.motivation: 阿拉伯经济体面临货币政策独立性与资本流动、汇率稳定之间的政策三元悖论约束，理解货币政策与宏观审慎政策之间的相互作用机制，对于设计有效的宏观经济稳定政策组合至关重要。
AI.theoretical_framework: 货币政策传导机制理论、宏观审慎政策框架、政策互动理论、三元悖论（不可能三角）理论、信贷渠道机制
AI.method: 采用2010-2024年12个阿拉伯经济体的非平衡面板数据，使用动态系统GMM（System GMM）框架进行估计，处理潜在的内生性和动态持续性问题，估计货币政策和宏观审慎政策的直接效应和交互效应对经济增长和信贷动态的影响。
AI.findings: 1. 货币紧缩对经济增长有显著的负向影响，而宏观审慎政策对宏观韧性有正向贡献；2. 货币政策与宏观审慎政策的交互项显著为正，表明宏观审慎政策强度能缓释货币紧缩对产出的负面影响；3. 这一互补效应在固定汇率制度下更为显著；4. 协调的政策行动能有效抑制过度的信贷扩张，支持信贷渠道机制。
AI.theory_contributions: 为货币政策与宏观审慎政策互动关系提供了阿拉伯经济体的实证证据，揭示了汇率制度安排如何影响政策组合效果，丰富了新兴经济体宏观金融政策协调的理论理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为阿拉伯经济体及类似新兴市场的政策制定者提供了政策组合设计参考，特别是在固定汇率制度下应更依赖宏观审慎工具来弥补货币政策独立性受限的不足，建议实施协调的货币政策与宏观审慎政策以增强宏观金融稳定。

title: Instrumental Atavism: The Architecture of Digital Evolution - Why Legacy Control Instruments Obstruct Institutional Evolution and What Replaces Them

detail.title: Instrumental Atavism: The Architecture of Digital Evolution - Why Legacy Control Instruments Obstruct Institutional Evolution and What Replaces Them

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author is Co-Founder and Strategic Partner of Association SMINORA (La Rochelle, France), referenced in this article as the operational case evidence for the theoretical framework developed herein. This relationship is disclosed in the article's methodological note (Part IV). No financial conflict of interest exists.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This article is a theoretical conceptual paper. No human participants, patients, or personal data were involved. The case observations referenced in Part IV are drawn from the author's own documented professional experience and publicly available administrative records.

detail.abstract:
This article introduces Instrumental Atavism as an autonomous analytical category applicable across institutional governance systems. An Instrumental Atavism is a control mechanism, verification instrument, or governance tool that was functionally rational in a prior institutional environment—and has persisted into a transformed environment where it no longer fulfills its original function, while continuing to consume institutional resources, generate compliance costs, and obstruct the emergence of more effective alternatives. Instrumental Atavisms are not failures of design. They are failures of adaptation.

Three structural characteristics define an Instrumental Atavism: Discreteness (episodic control applied to a continuous reality); Stasis (static instruments in a dynamic environment); and Institutional Inertia (the organizational layer that protects atavistic instruments from replacement). Together, these produce Atavistic Compliance—formal adherence to instruments that no longer reflect verifiable reality. The system produces not safety, but the appearance of compliance. A ritual, not a verification.

Two levels of atavism are distinguished: Level 1 (reformable, original function retained) and Level 2—Institutional Self-Referentiality—where the institution exists exclusively to sustain its own infrastructure, producing compliance documentation without generating verifiable value for external constituencies. The Temporal Reset is introduced as a new diagnostic marker of Level 2: the unilateral redefinition of processing timelines without legal basis, absorbing external pressure without changing institutional behavior.

Three principles of Evolutionary Governance Architecture are proposed—Continuity, Verifiability, and Accessibility—generating the discipline of Evolutionary Institutional Design. Two conceptual measurement instruments are introduced: the Regulatory Friction Index (RFI, Minoretskii 2026b), measuring atavism cost at market entry, and the SMINORA Gap (Minoretskaia 2026c), measuring it at the point of consumer decision. The universal applicability of Instrumental Atavism is established not through enumeration but through structural criterion: wherever a governance instrument was designed for a prior technological environment and has persisted into a transformed one; wherever declaration and verifiability are architecturally separated—there the Instrumental Atavism is present.

The SMINORA EcoTech ecosystem (La Rochelle pilot, April–September 2026) is presented as the first documented operational implementation context for Evolutionary Institutional Design. The digital age does not abolish control. It makes the ritual of control obsolete.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"工具性返祖"（Instrumental Atavism）这一分析范畴，指代那些在旧制度环境中具有功能合理性、但已不适应新环境却依然存续的治理工具。文章界定了其三大结构特征（离散性、停滞性、制度惯性），区分了两个层级（可改革型与制度自我指涉型），并提出了进化式治理架构的三项原则（连续性、可验证性、可及性），最终以SMINORA EcoTech生态试点作为首次实践验证。
AI.research_question: 如何识别、诊断并改革那些在制度环境变迁后失效但依然存续的治理工具？
AI.motivation: 现有治理系统中存在大量"僵尸工具"——它们曾有效但已不适应新环境，却持续消耗资源、产生合规成本、阻碍更优替代方案的出现。这些并非设计失败，而是适应失败，需要一个新的分析范畴来系统化识别与改革。
AI.theoretical_framework: 工具性返祖理论（Instrumental Atavism）、进化式治理架构（Evolutionary Governance Architecture），核心概念包括：离散性（Discreteness）、停滞性（Stasis）、制度惯性（Institutional Inertia）、返祖合规（Atavistic Compliance）、制度自我指涉性（Institutional Self-Referentiality）、时间重置（Temporal Reset）。
AI.method: 概念建构与理论演绎，辅以SMINORA EcoTech生态系统（拉罗谢尔试点，2026年4月–9月）作为首次操作化实施案例。
AI.findings: 工具性返祖具有三个结构特征（离散性、停滞性、制度惯性），产生"返祖合规"——形式上遵守但不再反映可验证现实，合规沦为仪式而非验证。存在两个层级，其中第二级（制度自我指涉）的机构仅为自己存续而运作，产生合规文档但不对外部利益攸关方产生可验证价值。"时间重置"被提出作为第二级的诊断标志。进化式治理需遵循连续性、可验证性、可及性三原则。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次提出"工具性返祖"作为独立的制度分析范畴，建立了普遍适用性标准（不依赖枚举而依赖结构性判据），区分了制度退化的两个层级，引入了"时间重置"等新诊断工具。
AI.practical_contributions: 提出了进化式制度设计的学科方向，提供了两个测量工具（监管摩擦指数RFI和SMINORA Gap），并给出了SMINORA EcoTech作为首例实践验证案例。指出数字时代不会取消控制，但会使控制的仪式变得过时。

title: From Institutional Lock-In to Anticipatory Resilience: Operationalizing Strategic Foresight as a Parametric Meta-Governance Architecture for Socio-Ecological Systems

detail.title: From Institutional Lock-In to Anticipatory Resilience: Operationalizing Strategic Foresight as a Parametric Meta-Governance Architecture for Socio-Ecological Systems

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial or personal interests that could have influenced the work reported in this manuscript.
declarations.ethicsApproval: Informed consent was obtained in writing from all participants. Participation was voluntary, with explicit withdrawal options and confidentiality guarantees.
declarations.funderStatement: This research did not receive any specific grant from funding agencies in the public, commercial, or not-for-profit sectors.

detail.abstract: Territorial governance in the Global South faces a structural paradox: decentralized socio-ecological systems demand polycentric coordination, yet available institutional architectures remain linear, reactive, and ill-equipped to absorb systemic disruptions. Strategic foresight has been proposed as a corrective; however, no translational framework converts abstract resilience principles into parametric, binding decision-support instruments. This study addresses this gap by operationalizing the Prospective Adaptive Tourism Governance Model (MOPGTA), a meta-governance architecture designed to shift territorial networks from path-dependent stagnation toward anticipatory resilience. Using a sequential exploratory mixed-methods design, the research unfolded across three phases: (i) comparative analysis of 36 governance cases triangulated with 36 local stakeholder assessments, distilling five operative governance dimensions; (ii) MICMAC structural analysis in which a 14-expert panel prioritized 17 system variables from a 54-variable inventory and a 5-expert technical panel completed the resulting 17×17 cross-impact matrix (73% fill rate; convergence at the 7th iteration), yielding four sentinel dimensions MARPOLINT, COORDINT, ORGEX, and SEGRESADA as an early-warning parametric subsystem; and (iii) morphological scenario construction with 22 territorial decision-makers, with the model independently validated by 22 evaluators via the Analytic Hierarchy Process (Kendall’s W = 0.73). The MOPGTA integrates 25 sentinel indicators and 12 sequential contingency protocols (M1-M12) into a double-loop learning mechanism activated by mathematically defined thresholds, enabling polycentric networks to reconfigure institutional rules before critical transitions erode system viability. Beyond its tourism testbed, the MOPGTA constitutes a transferable algorithmic governance technology for commons management under deep uncertainty the first operationalized parametric architecture bridging anticipatory intelligence with polycentric institutional design in the Global South.

AI.tldr: 本研究提出了前瞻性适应性旅游治理模型（MOPGTA），一种将抽象韧性原则转化为可操作参数化决策支持工具的元治理架构，通过三阶段混合方法设计（36案例比较、MICMAC结构分析、形态情景构建）在Global South验证，整合25个哨兵指标和12个应急协议，实现多中心网络在临界转变前的制度规则重构。
AI.research_question: 如何将抽象的前瞻性韧性原则转化为可操作的、参数化的约束性决策支持工具，以解决Global South去中心化社会-生态系统面临的治理结构性悖论？
AI.motivation: Global South去中心化的社会-生态系统需要多中心协调，但现有制度架构线性、反应式且无法吸收系统性干扰；战略前瞻虽被提出作为纠正方案，但缺乏将抽象韧性原则转化为可操作决策支持工具的翻译框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 元治理架构（Meta-governance）、多中心协调理论（Polycentric coordination）、前瞻性韧性（Anticipatory resilience）、双环学习机制（Double-loop learning）
AI.method: 顺序探索性混合方法设计：阶段一：36个治理案例的比较分析+36位地方利益相关者评估；阶段二：14位专家组的MICMAC结构分析（54变量→17变量，17×17交叉影响矩阵，73%填充率，第7次迭代收敛）；阶段三：22位领土决策者参与形态情景构建，模型由22位评估者通过层次分析法（AHP）独立验证（Kendall’s W = 0.73）。
AI.findings: 提炼出五个操作性治理维度；通过MICMAC分析获得四个哨兵维度（MARPOLINT, COORDINT, ORGEX, SEGRESADA）作为早期预警参数子系统；MOPGTA整合25个哨兵指标和12个序列应急协议（M1-M12）进入由数学定义阈值激活的双环学习机制，使多中心网络能在关键转变侵蚀系统可行性前重新配置制度规则。
AI.theory_contributions: 首次将前瞻性智能与Global South的多中心制度设计进行操作性参数化对接，构建了第一个可操作的参数化架构，为深度不确定性下的公地治理提供了可转移的算法治理技术。
AI.practical_contributions: 为Global South领土治理提供了从路径依赖向前瞻性韧性转变的约束性决策支持工具；超越旅游场景，为公地治理提供可转移的算法治理技术。

affiliations: Central Bank of Nigeria

detail.title: Is Fintech Doing Too Much for Financial Inclusion?

publicationDetails.detailsText: Building Inclusive and Resilient Financial Ecosystems in the Digital Age, Springer.

detail.abstract: In this article, I argue that an inflection point exist when using fintech innovation to increase the level of financial inclusion. Using fintech to increase financial inclusion is good, but doing too much with fintech for financial inclusion is not a good idea because all fintech innovation will reach an inflection point where further use of fintech innovation to promote financial inclusion leads to negative consequences on people's wellbeing. I argue that the potential for 'too much' fintech innovation to lead to negative outcomes for financial inclusion calls for sober reflection on the need for moderation and balance in using fintech innovation to accelerate financial inclusion.

AI.tldr: 本文论证了利用金融科技创新促进金融包容性存在一个拐点：适度使用是有益的，但过度使用会适得其反，对人民福祉产生负面影响，因此需要在创新中寻求平衡与适度。
AI.research_question: 金融科技创新在促进金融包容性方面是否存在一个"过度"的拐点？过度使用金融科技创新会带来哪些负面后果？
AI.motivation: 当前对金融科技促进金融包容性的讨论多强调其积极面，但忽视了"过度"可能带来的负面效应，作者旨在提出警示，呼吁对金融科技创新的"适度"与"平衡"进行理性反思。
AI.theoretical_framework: 拐点理论（Inflection Point Theory）；适度与平衡原则。
AI.method: 理论论证与概念性分析。
AI.findings: 金融科技促进金融包容性并非"越多越好"，存在一个拐点：拐点之前，金融科技创新对金融包容性有正向促进作用；拐点之后，过度使用会带来负面后果，损害人民福祉。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"金融科技创新促进金融包容性存在拐点"这一理论观点，丰富了金融科技与金融包容性研究的理论边界，为相关领域提供了新的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为政策制定者和金融从业者提供了警示：在推动金融科技创新促进金融包容性时，应注重适度与平衡，避免"过度创新"带来的负面社会影响。

title: Blockchain Technology, Brics Pay Consortium, And the Private International Challenges of Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (Daos)
affiliations: University of Detroit Mercy School of Law

detail.title: Blockchain Technology, Brics Pay Consortium, And the Private International Challenges of Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (Daos)
detail.abstract: The emergence of Decentralized Autonomous Organizations (DAOs) represents a paradigm shift in organizational governance, replacing traditional corporate structures with algorithmically governed models on blockchain networks. This article provides an analysis of the private international law (PIL) challenges posed by the BRICS Pay Consortium, a proposed decentralized payment messaging system for BRICS member states, modeled on DAO principles. The BRICS Pay Consortium DAO highlights a fundamental tension between the transnational and often decentralized nature of blockchain and conventional territorial legal frameworks. The Consortium is designed to operate without a central headquarters or legal personality, thus undermining traditional PIL connecting factors—such as domicile, registered office, and principal place of business—used to determine jurisdiction and applicable law. The article examines divergent global framework for the regulation of DAOs. By evaluating current responses—including statutory legal wrappers and on-chain dispute resolution—this article demonstrates that existing doctrines are inadequate for decentralized entities. It concludes that existing frameworks on jurisdiction and choice of law are currently inadequate for the complexities of the BRICS Pay Consortium DAO. Ultimately, the article argues that resolving these challenges requires a transition from traditional territorial models toward regulatory innovation, contractual best practices, and cross border cooperation.

AI.tldr: 本文分析了BRICS Pay联盟DAO（一种基于区块链的去中心化支付系统）对传统国际私法（PIL）提出的挑战，指出其无总部、无法人资格的特性使得传统的属地管辖和法律适用规则失效，并论证现有法律框架无法应对此类去中心化实体，呼吁向监管创新、合同实践和跨境合作转型。
AI.research_question: 去中心化自治组织（DAO）——以BRICS Pay联盟为例——对国际私法中管辖权确定和准据法选择规则提出了哪些挑战？
AI.motivation: BRICS Pay联盟DAO作为一种无中心总部和法人资格的去中心化支付系统，与传统属地法律框架存在根本性张力，而现有国际私法规则（如住所、注册地、主要营业地等连接因素）无法有效适用于此类实体，亟需理论分析。
AI.theoretical_framework: 国际私法（PIL）中的管辖权理论、法律选择理论、传统连接因素（住所、注册地、主要营业地）理论，以及DAO的算法治理理论。
AI.method: 规范分析与比较法研究。通过审视各国对DAO的监管框架（包括法定法律包装和链上争议解决机制），评估现有规则对去中心化实体的适用性。
AI.findings: 1. 现有的国际私法连接因素（住所、注册地、主要营业地等）不适用于无中央总部的BRICS Pay联盟DAO；2. 各国现有的法定法律包装和链上争议解决机制不足以解决管辖权与法律适用问题；3. 当前属地主义框架无法处理去中心化实体的复杂性。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了传统国际私法中的属地管辖权与连接因素理论在面对DAO等去中心化实体时的结构性不足，为国际私法理论的范式转型提供了实证依据。
AI.practical_contributions: 为BRICS国家及国际社会制定DAO监管政策提供了问题诊断，指出需通过监管创新、合同最佳实践和跨境合作来应对去中心化治理带来的法律挑战。

title: Budgeting for Capital Calls: A VaR-Inspired Approach
affiliations: Independant and Burgiss

detail.title: Budgeting for Capital Calls: A VaR-Inspired Approach
detail.abstract: In this paper we discuss the importance, and challenges, of forecasting private capital cash flows. Particularly important is forecasting capital calls, since they constitute liabilities for the investor. While it is useful to know the expected capital calls arising from an investor's portfolio, it is more important to estimate a likely upper bound on those calls, since this will determine the reserves needed in order to safely service the calls. To this end, we introduce a new concept, namely that of maximum probable contributions-a statistic which, subject to a user-specified confidence level, serves as such an upper bound. We explore in detail a historical methodology for its computation, illustrate typical model predictions, and document its out-of-sample performance during backtesting on both funds and portfolios of funds.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"最大可能出资额"概念，用于预测私募资本现金流的上限，帮助投资者设定安全储备金以应对资本催缴义务。
AI.research_question: 如何有效预测私募资本现金流，特别是为资本催缴设定一个统计上的上限？
AI.motivation: 私募资本的资本催缴构成投资者的负债，已知期望值不足以管理风险，需要估计一个可能的上限以确定安全储备金。
AI.theoretical_framework: 最大可能出资额概念，基于历史模拟方法和用户指定的置信水平。
AI.method: 历史模拟方法计算最大可能出资额，并在基金和基金组合上进行样本外回测验证。
AI.findings: 最大可能出资额能够作为资本催缴的统计上限，在样本外回测中表现良好。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"最大可能出资额"这一新概念，将风险管理思想引入私募资本现金流预测领域。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者提供量化工具，帮助确定应对资本催缴所需的安全储备金规模，降低流动性风险。

title: A 3ⁿ Decomposition of Asset Returns: Level-Slope-Curvature Factors and Asset Pricing
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A 3ⁿ Decomposition of Asset Returns: Level-Slope-Curvature Factors and Asset Pricing
detail.abstract: This study develops a data-driven approach to factor identification and asset pricing based on the internal covariance structure of asset returns. Using principal component analysis applied to portfolios structured by fundamental characteristics, the framework extracts latent factors that exhibit a stable and economically interpretable level-slope-curvature structure. The extracted factors are incorporated into a linear factor pricing framework and evaluated using cross-sectional asset pricing tests. The results show that while the first (market-like) component captures common variation in returns, higher-order components play a more prominent role in explaining expected returns. This suggests that systematic risk is not fully captured by aggregate market exposure but is instead concentrated in specific structural dimensions of the return space. The approach is further extended to a multidimensional setting in the form of the proposed 3ⁿ Decomposition Model, which allows for interactions between characteristics and provides a richer representation of the underlying risk structure. Overall, the findings contribute to the empirical asset pricing literature by providing a bridge between data-driven factor extraction and economically interpretable multifactor pricing models.

AI.tldr: 本文基于资产收益的内部协方差结构，利用主成分分析提取出具有水平-斜率-曲率结构的潜在因子，并构建3ⁿ分解模型，发现高阶成分在解释预期收益中起更重要作用，为数据驱动因子提取与经济可解释的多因子定价模型搭建了桥梁。
AI.research_question: 如何基于资产收益的内部协方差结构，通过数据驱动方法识别具有经济解释意义的潜在因子，并构建多因子资产定价模型？
AI.motivation: 传统因子定价模型依赖于预先指定的因子（如市场因子），但系统性风险可能并未被市场总体暴露充分捕获，需要从数据中提取更精细的结构化风险维度。
AI.theoretical_framework: 主成分分析（PCA）；线性因子定价框架；水平-斜率-曲率结构；3ⁿ分解模型（多维交互结构）。
AI.method: 对按基本面特征构建的投资组合进行主成分分析提取潜在因子，纳入线性因子定价模型，通过横截面资产定价检验评估因子表现，并拓展至3ⁿ分解模型以捕捉特征间的交互作用。
AI.findings: 第一主成分（类市场因子）捕获收益的共性变动，但高阶成分在解释预期收益中扮演更重要的角色；系统性风险集中于收益空间的特定结构维度；3ⁿ分解模型提供了更丰富的风险结构表征。
AI.theory_contributions: 在数据驱动因子提取与经济可解释的多因子定价模型之间建立了桥梁；揭示了系统性风险的多维结构性质，挑战了单一市场因子足以定价的传统观点。
AI.practical_contributions: 为资产定价实践提供了系统性的数据驱动因子识别方法；3ⁿ分解模型可用于更精确地刻画资产的风险暴露和预期收益。

title: Real-time geometric-physical co-simulation of milling process: a digital twin method of model-data fusion
affiliations: affiliation not provided to SSRN, affiliation not provided to SSRN, Tsinghua University and affiliation not provided to SSRN

detail.title: Real-time geometric-physical co-simulation of milling process: a digital twin method of model-data fusion
detail.abstract: Current machining digital twin systems generally face limitations such as the separation of geometric simulation and physical prediction, computing power bottlenecks, and the lack of interpretability. Thus, this work proposes a digital twin method for real-time geometric-physical co-simulation of milling process, and innovatively constructs a causal modeling paradigm where geometric evolution drives physical update. This method relies on the endogenous data of the numerical control system and adopts the lightweight dynamic triangular mesh algorithm to reconstruct the geometric field of the workpiece surface in real time. Furthermore, the instantaneous cutting depth and width are reverse-extracted from the changes in the grid topology as the dynamic boundary conditions to drive the physical mechanism model. Ultimately, through three-dimensional in-situ visualization algorithm, the physical quantities such as cutting force are isomorphic mapped to geometric vertices, achieving an integrated expression of shaping and property. Taking the cavity milling of aviation aluminum alloy thin-walled frame-type part as an example, a system-level verification was carried out. The results show that the system achieves stable operation at 10 to 15 FPS with extremely low computing power without relying on external sensors at all. This study has established a real-time twin framework that combines geometric high fidelity and physical interpretability, providing a universal theoretical basis and technical path for the process transparency perception, quality traceability and adaptive decision-making of intelligent manufacturing system.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于几何驱动物理更新的铣削过程数字孪生方法，通过轻量级动态三角网格算法和内生数据驱动，实现了几何-物理实时协同仿真，在极低算力下达到10-15 FPS的稳定运行，为智能制造的透明化感知与自适应决策提供了理论基础。
AI.research_question: 如何构建一种实时几何-物理协同仿真的铣削过程数字孪生方法，以解决现有系统几何仿真与物理预测分离、算力瓶颈和缺乏可解释性的问题？
AI.motivation: 现有加工数字孪生系统存在几何仿真与物理预测分离、算力瓶颈、缺乏可解释性三大局限，亟需一种兼具几何高保真度和物理可解释性的实时协同仿真框架。
AI.theoretical_framework: 几何演化驱动物理更新的因果建模范式；轻量级动态三角网格算法；瞬时切削深度/宽度逆向提取方法；三维原位可视化算法。
AI.method: 依赖数控系统内生数据，采用轻量级动态三角网格算法实时重构工件表面几何场；从网格拓扑变化中逆向提取瞬时切削深度和宽度作为动态边界条件，驱动物理机制模型；通过三维原位可视化算法将切削力等物理量同构映射到几何顶点。
AI.findings: 以航空铝合金薄壁框体零件型腔铣削为例进行系统级验证，系统在完全不依赖外部传感器的情况下，以极低算力实现10-15 FPS的稳定运行。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了几何演化驱动物理更新的因果建模新范式，为数字孪生中的几何-物理协同仿真提供了理论框架；建立了实时孪生框架，将几何高保真度与物理可解释性相统一。
AI.practical_contributions: 为智能制造系统的过程透明感知、质量追溯和自适应决策提供了通用理论依据和技术路径；实现了低算力、无外部传感器的实时数字孪生系统，具有良好的工程应用前景。

title: Employees' Implicit Leadership Theories and Their Parents' Parenting Styles
affiliations: Minzu University of China, Hong Kong Baptist University, Hong Kong Baptist University, Hong Kong Baptist University and Hebei Normal University

detail.title: Employees' Implicit Leadership Theories and Their Parents' Parenting Styles
detail.abstract: An organizational leader may be accepted and lauded by many employees while simultaneously drawing the ire of others. Research on implicit leadership theories suggests that this occurs because employees hold diverse cognitive schemas regarding what constitutes a prototypical leader. Yet the sources of these individual differences remain poorly understood. Drawing on imprinting theory and leader categorization theory, we propose that employees' childhood experiences with their parents leave lasting imprints on their implicit leadership prototypes, and that the influence of these prototypes on leadership perceptions is both automatic and enduring. In Study 1, we use an implicit association test to establish a link between parents' parenting styles and the leadership prototypes employees implicitly endorse in adulthood. In Study 2, we further demonstrate that parenting styles provide meaningful explanations for why some employees tolerate authoritarian leaders while others do not, and why some employees respond more positively to participative leaders than others, with affective trust and work performance as downstream outcomes. This research advances understanding of how early childhood socialization shapes the formation and persistence of implicit leadership theories and their long-lasting influence on employees' reactions to leaders throughout adulthood.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了员工童年时期父母教养方式如何塑造其内隐领导原型，进而影响成年后对领导者的感知和反应。通过两项研究（内隐联想测试和实地调查）发现，父母教养方式（专制型vs.民主型）会形成长期稳定的内隐领导原型，影响员工对不同领导风格（威权型vs.参与型）的接受度和信任、绩效表现。
AI.research_question: 员工的童年父母教养经历如何影响其内隐领导原型，进而影响其对不同类型领导者的感知和反应？
AI.motivation: 已有研究表明员工持有多样化的内隐领导理论（对理想领导的认知图式），但对这些个体差异的来源理解不足。本文试图从童年社会化经历（特别是父母教养方式）这一深层次角度解释内隐领导原型的形成机制。
AI.theoretical_framework: 印记理论（Imprinting Theory）和领导分类理论（Leader Categorization Theory）。印记理论解释童年经历如何留下持久影响；领导分类理论解释员工如何根据内在的领导原型来识别和评价领导者。
AI.method: 两项研究：研究1采用内隐联想测验（IAT）测量员工内隐层面的领导原型；研究2通过实地调查收集数据，考察父母教养方式对员工接受威权型和参与型领导的影响，以及情感信任和工作绩效作为结果变量。
AI.findings: 父母教养方式与员工内隐认可的领导原型之间存在关联；专制型父母教养经历使员工更可能接受威权型领导，民主型父母教养经历使员工更积极回应参与型领导；这些影响通过情感信任传导至工作绩效。
AI.theory_contributions: 将印记理论引入领导力研究领域，揭示了童年早期社会化经历（父母教养）如何形成并维持内隐领导理论；证明内隐领导原型的形成具有自动性和持久性特征；从根源上解释了员工之间领导感知差异的来源。
AI.practical_contributions: 提示组织管理者需要认识到员工对领导风格的差异化反应可能源于童年经历；为组织在领导选聘、团队配置和管理培训中考虑员工异质性提供了理论依据；帮助领导者理解为什么同一种领导行为会在不同员工中引发不同反应。

title: AI-Ready? How African Governments Are Assembling Policy in Anticipation of Data-And AI-Driven Techno-Futures
affiliations: university of witwatersrand

detail.title: AI-Ready? How African Governments Are Assembling Policy in Anticipation of Data-And AI-Driven Techno-Futures

declarations.declarationOfInterest: This paper is solely authored and was not funded by any agency.
declarations.ethicsApproval: this paper is conceptual, it was written using desktop review.

detail.abstract: With the current growth of artificial intelligence (AI)-driven applications in Africa, and the increasing media attention devoted to data-driven decision-making in virtually all key spaces in government as well as in society, policymakers are becoming increasingly aware that AI driven ecosystems are inevitable. In this chapter I draw from feminist science and technology studies (STS) approaches to discuss how different governments are anticipating AI technologies, paying particular attention to the ways this anticipation relates to the framing and reframing of public policies. Of interest is the way in which policy strategies capture or mute the role of the institutions and the people who will shape AI investment, design and use, as well as overall governance. By examining the three publicly available AI policy strategies, the chapter examines how different governments on the continent are anticipating and framing AI techno-futures. The chapter responds to the question: What do the publicly available AI policy strategies reveal about how African governments are framing and anticipating AI techno-futures? It tries to compare how different policies are framed, as well as to reveal how governments see AI and big data compared to how the market sees them. The policies analysed reveal that African governments foreground technological advancement, economic growth and research, and are less focused on people and institutions whose role is important in determining how the value in the technology may be shared equitably. The chapter argues that African governments and critical AI scholars must invest in policy methodologies that counteract the tendency of large and emerging tech actors to presume an inevitable journey of converting data to monetisable knowledge and other useful products. The chapter proposes that governments and AI-critical scholars should start seeing like a market by focusing on the apparent assemblage of power, knowledge and profits, and advancing policy frameworks that require a comprehensive account of how value is extracted from data collection processes, and how this ‘value’ translates to the flourishing or disenfranchising of the populations from which data is extracted. The chapter reveals some gaps in and challenges to deliberative policy assemblage and engagement in relation to AI techno-futures in Africa. It proposes some of the ways different actors could contribute meaningfully to AI policies through deliberative policy processes.

AI.tldr: 本文从女性主义科学技术研究视角，分析非洲国家公开的人工智能政策战略，发现这些政策侧重技术发展、经济增长和研究，而较少关注人和制度在公平分配技术价值中的作用。文章建议政府和学者应关注权力、知识与利润的整合，推动考虑数据价值提取过程的政策框架。
AI.research_question: 非洲国家公开的人工智能政策战略如何揭示它们如何框架化和预期AI技术未来？
AI.motivation: 随着AI驱动应用在非洲增长，政策制定者意识到AI生态系统不可避免，但现有政策如何框架化AI未来及其对人和制度的影响尚不清晰。
AI.theoretical_framework: 女性主义科学技术研究（Feminist STS）
AI.method: 对三项公开可用的非洲AI政策战略进行文本分析，比较不同政策框架以及政府与市场看待AI和大数据的差异。
AI.findings: 非洲AI政策重技术发展、经济增长和研究，轻人和制度角色；政策未能充分考虑数据价值的公平分配。
AI.theory_contributions: 将女性主义STS视角引入非洲AI政策研究，揭示政策框架中权力、知识与利润的整合关系，提出"像市场一样看"的分析视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 建议非洲政府和AI批评学者投资于政策方法论以抵消大型科技公司的数据货币化倾向；推动考虑数据价值提取过程的政策框架；促进多元行动者通过协商性政策过程参与AI治理。

title: A Value-Flow Company Model: Designing Organizations Through Value Flows, Roles, Artifacts, and Review Loops
affiliations: Independent

detail.title: A Value-Flow Company Model: Designing Organizations Through Value Flows, Roles, Artifacts, and Review Loops

declarations.declarationOfInterest: The author declares no competing financial interests.
declarations.ethicsApproval: This conceptual study did not involve human participants, patients, animals, or personal data.
declarations.funderStatement: This research received no external funding.

detail.abstract: Organizations often coordinate work through departments, job titles, task lists, meetings, chats and performance indicators that are only weakly connected to one another. This creates recurring management problems: activity is mistaken for value creation, responsibilities are attached to people without a clear work product, repeated work does not reliably become reusable knowledge or capability, and metrics become disconnected from artifacts and review decisions. This working paper introduces the Value-Flow Company Model as a design artifact for describing and designing organizations through explicit links between purpose, value flows, directions, tracks, roles, work packages, result artifacts, confirmation evidence, metrics, KPI and review loops. The model treats a company as a system of value movement rather than as a static hierarchy. A role is defined as responsibility for a work product. A result is treated as managed when it has an artifact and a confirmation path. The paper positions the model as a conceptual design-science contribution that requires later empirical testing. Its central argument is that an organization becomes more governable when work is represented through a chain from value to responsibility, artifact, evidence and review. The model is applicable across organizational types, while being especially useful where people combine multiple responsibilities or where work is distributed across projects, products, services and support activities.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了"价值流公司模型"（Value-Flow Company Model），将组织视为价值流动系统，通过明确连接目的、价值流、方向、轨道、角色、工作包、结果工件、确认证据、指标、KPI和评审回路，使组织更具可治理性。
AI.research_question: 如何通过显式连接价值、责任、工件、证据和评审来设计更具可治理性的组织？
AI.motivation: 现有组织常通过部门、职位、任务列表、会议、聊天和绩效指标来协调工作，但这些要素之间联系薄弱，导致活动被误认为价值创造、责任与工作产品脱钩、重复工作未能转化为可复用的知识或能力、指标与工件和评审决策脱节等管理问题。
AI.theoretical_framework: 价值流公司模型（Value-Flow Company Model），将公司视为价值运动系统而非静态层级结构，核心概念包括价值流、方向、轨道、角色（定义为对工作产品的责任）、结果（有工件和确认路径即被视为已管理）。
AI.method: 设计科学研究（Design-Science Research），提出概念性设计工件，后续需实证检验。
AI.findings: 当工作通过"价值→责任→工件→证据→评审"的链条被表征时，组织更具可治理性。该模型适用于多种组织类型，尤其适用于人员承担多重职责或工作分布在项目、产品、服务和支持活动中的场景。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一种将组织视为价值流动系统的概念性设计框架，通过显式链接价值、责任、工件、证据和评审，为组织设计提供了新的理论视角。
AI.practical_contributions: 为管理者提供了一种具体的设计工具，帮助解决活动与价值脱节、责任与工作产品不匹配、知识复用不足、指标与评审脱节等实际管理问题。

title: Cadent: Managing AI Transformation in the Connected TV Advertising Industry
affiliations: Gabelli School of Business, Fordham University and Fordham University - Gabelli School of Business

detail.title: Cadent: Managing AI Transformation in the Connected TV Advertising Industry
detail.abstract: In late 2025, Michael Michelini, Senior Vice President at Cadent, prepared to speak at a technology roundtable hosted by Fordham University. Artificial Intelligence has become the dominant topic across the technology and advertising industries. Nearly every company was experimenting with new AI tools, and executives were under pressure to demonstrate how their organizations were responding to the rapid technological shift. Across the advertising technology sector, companies were rushing to introduce generative AI tools promising dramatic improvements in targeting, campaign planning, and automation. Yet Michelini observed that many organizations were experimenting with ad-hoc tools without a coherent strategy for scaling AI across their operations.

AI.tldr: 本文以Cadent公司高管Michael Michelini在福特汉姆大学科技圆桌会议上的发言为背景，探讨了广告技术行业在人工智能浪潮下面临的战略挑战：企业虽积极尝试各类AI工具，但普遍缺乏将AI规模化整合到运营中的连贯战略。
AI.research_question: 广告技术企业如何在缺乏连贯战略的情况下有效扩展AI工具的应用？
AI.motivation: 观察到广告技术行业中许多企业虽然热衷于尝试各种生成式AI工具，但缺乏系统性的规模化战略，因此有必要探讨如何制定和执行有效的AI扩展策略。
AI.theoretical_framework: 技术采纳与扩散理论、组织战略管理理论、AI转型框架
AI.method: 案例分析方法，基于高管演讲与行业观察
AI.findings: 广告技术企业在AI应用上存在“试点多、战略少”的普遍问题，即企业虽然积极探索AI工具，但未能建立从实验到规模化部署的清晰路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 揭示了AI技术采纳过程中“实验与战略脱节”的典型困境，丰富了技术扩散理论在AI时代的应用理解。
AI.practical_contributions: 为广告技术企业及其他行业提供警示：单纯追逐AI工具热潮而不制定系统性规模化战略，难以实现真正的竞争优势。

title: Bias-Corrected Method of Moments Estimation for Short-T Dynamic Panel Data Models with Latent Group Structure

detail.title: Bias-Corrected Method of Moments Estimation for Short-T Dynamic Panel Data Models with Latent Group Structure
detail.abstract: This paper proposes a bias-corrected method of moments estimator for short dynamic panel data models in which the slope coefficients vary across an unknown number of latent groups. Group membership is treated as an unobserved discrete classification, and within each group the slope coefficients are common. The estimator combines a within-group bias-corrected moment condition derived from the profile score of the Gaussian likelihood with a classification rule that minimises a quadratic form in the bias-corrected moments. The leading bias arising from the incidental parameters problem under fixed time dimension is removed within groups, and the classification step recovers the latent partition with probability approaching one as both the crosssectional and the time dimensions grow, with the time dimension entering because classification of individual units requires the within-unit information to accumulate. The proposed estimator extends established split-panel jackknife bias correction methods to settings with discrete unobserved heterogeneity in the slopes, and it complements existing approaches based on quasidifferencing and the common correlated effects principle. Post-classification consistency and asymptotic normality of the group-specific coefficients are established under fixed time dimension and large cross-section, classification consistency is established as the time dimension grows, and a consistent rule for selecting the number of groups is provided.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种针对短动态面板数据模型的偏差校正矩估计方法，该模型允许斜率系数在未知数量的潜在组间变化。通过结合组内偏差校正矩条件和分类规则，该方法能够同时实现参数估计和组别分类，并证明了在时间维度固定、截面维度大时的后分类一致性和渐进正态性。
AI.research_question: 如何对斜率系数在未知潜在组间变化的短动态面板数据模型进行有效的估计和分类？
AI.motivation: 短动态面板数据中，当斜率系数存在未知组别异质性时，传统的固定效应或随机效应模型无法捕捉这种结构变化。现有方法（如准差分或共同相关效应）在处理离散未观测异质性时存在局限，且固定时间维度下的 incidental parameters problem 会导致估计偏差。
AI.theoretical_framework: 1. 基于高斯似然剖面得分的组内偏差校正矩条件；2. 基于偏差校正矩的二次型最小化分类规则；3. 分裂面板刀切法（split-panel jackknife）偏差校正方法。
AI.method: 提出一种偏差校正的矩估计量：首先利用高斯似然的剖面得分推导组内偏差校正矩条件，消除固定时间维度下 incidental parameters problem 带来的偏差；然后通过最小化偏差校正矩的二次型进行分类，恢复潜在的分组结构。当时间和截面维度同时增长时，分类一致性趋于1。
AI.findings: 1. 在固定时间维度、大截面条件下，后分类估计的组别特定系数具有一致性和渐进正态性；2. 随着时间维度增长，分类具有一致性（即正确分类的概率趋近于1）；3. 提供了可用于选择组数的准则。
AI.theory_contributions: 将分裂面板刀切法偏差校正方法扩展到斜率存在离散未观测异质性的情境，补充了基于准差分和共同相关效应原理的现有方法。
AI.practical_contributions: 为实证研究中处理面板数据中未知的组别异质性提供了可行的估计和分类方法，适用于宏观经济、金融等领域中个体可能属于不同潜在群组的动态面板数据分析。

detail.title: Investigating the Dynamic Interlinkages between Exchange Rates and the NSE NIFTY Index

publicationDetails.detailsText: Journal of Risk and Financial Management, volume 14, issue 1, 2021[10.3390/jrfm14010020]

detail.abstract: This study aims at examining the short-run and long-run dynamic linkages among exchange rates and stock market index in India through a structured cointegration and Granger causality tests. Daily exchange rates of USD, EUR, CNY, JPY, and GBP to INR along with the daily movement of NSE NIFTY for a period spanning 13 years from 6 September 2005 to 31 December 2018 were used for the analysis. The results reveal that there is no evidence for a stable long-run relationship between NSE NIFTY and the exchange rates under study. However, the VAR-based Granger causality test shows that USD, JPY, and CNY have short-run causal relationship with NSE NIFTY. The NSE NIFTY also seemed to have an influence on USD expressed in terms of Indian rupee. The impulse response analysis further supports the results of the Granger causality test and provides information on the time required for the NSE NIFTY index to recover from a shock caused by the fluctuation in exchange rates.

AI.tldr: 本文研究印度汇率与股票市场指数（NSE NIFTY）之间的短期和长期动态关联，发现两者间不存在长期稳定关系，但美元、日元和人民币与NIFTY存在短期因果关系。
AI.research_question: 印度卢比兑美元、欧元、人民币、日元、英镑的汇率与印度NSE NIFTY股指之间是否存在短期和长期的动态关联？
AI.motivation: 在全球化背景下，汇率波动与股票市场之间的相互影响对投资者和政策制定者具有重要意义，而印度作为新兴市场经济体，其汇率与股市的关系尚需深入实证检验。
AI.theoretical_framework: 结构化协整理论（检验长期关系）；Granger因果关系检验（检验短期因果关系）；脉冲响应分析（检验冲击的动态影响）。
AI.method: 采用2005年9月6日至2018年12月31日共13年的日度数据，运用协整检验、VAR模型基础上的Granger因果检验和脉冲响应分析进行实证研究。
AI.findings: 1）NSE NIFTY与各汇率之间不存在长期稳定关系；2）美元、日元、人民币与NIFTY存在短期Granger因果关系；3）NIFTY对美元/卢比汇率也有影响；4）脉冲响应分析进一步支持了因果检验结果，并揭示了股指受汇率冲击后的恢复时间。
AI.theory_contributions: 丰富和拓展了新兴市场国家汇率与股市联动关系的理论文献，提供了印度市场长短期关系不一致的实证证据，质疑了传统上假设的长期稳定关系。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度及类似新兴市场的投资者提供了汇率风险管理的参考依据，帮助政策制定者理解汇率波动对股市的短期冲击效应及其持续时间。

detail.abstract: Public K-12 systems legally require children to attend a large number of instructional hours each year, but official budgets recognize only the cost of adult labor. This creates an accounting puzzle: is there any fiscal object that explicitly values student time? We propose a framework to quantify this fiscal nonrecognition. We define Compulsory Student Hours (CSH) as the total mandated student time, where CSH = i E i H i w i , E i is enrollment in group i, H i is required hours per year for group i, and w i is a compulsion weight. We impute a dollar value, Imputed Student Time Value (ISTV), by multiplying CSH by an hourly benchmark V. We identify any actual Recognized Student-Time Dollars (RSD), defined as direct payments to students for required attendance, and compute the Student Time Recognition Rate (STRR), where STRR = RSD/ISTV. Using national data of approximately 49.2 million public K-12 students, roughly 1,000 statutory hours per year, and a conservative federal minimum-wage benchmark of $7.25 per hour, the resulting ISTV is on the order of $3.57×10 11. In ordinary public finance there are effectively no direct student-time payments, yielding STRR ≈ 0. These are order-of-magnitude illustrations: if H = 1,080 or V = $15, ISTV rises, but RSD remains approximately zero. The results highlight a stark asymmetry: schools' budgets explicitly account for teacher and staff time, but institutionally required student time has virtually no direct fiscal counterpart. This is a descriptive accounting exercise, not a claim that students are owed wages or a policy proposal. The contribution is a neutral, replicable method for measuring the gap between adult labor accounting and student-time accounting in K-12 finance.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一个量化公立K-12教育系统中学生时间财政不承认的框架，通过定义"强制学生学时"(CSH)和"推定学生时间价值"(ISTV)，发现学生时间几乎没有任何直接的财政对应物（STRR≈0），与成人劳动力被明确核算形成鲜明对比。
AI.research_question: 公立K-12教育系统中，是否存在任何明确对学生时间进行估值的财政对象？学生时间在多大程度上被财政体系所承认？
AI.motivation: 公立K-12系统强制要求学生投入大量教学时间，但官方预算只承认成人劳动力成本。这种会计上的不一致亟需量化分析，以揭示财政体系中对学生时间与成人劳动力时间的处理差异。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于公共财政会计理论，提出"强制学生学时"(CSH)、"推定学生时间价值"(ISTV)、"已承认学生时间美元"(RSD)和"学生时间承认率"(STRR)四个核心概念，构建了学生时间财政承认的测量框架。
AI.method: 描述性会计方法。使用全国约4920万公立K-12学生数据，约1000法定学时/年，以联邦最低工资$7.25/小时为保守基准，进行数量级估算。
AI.findings: ISTV约为$3.57×10^11（约3570亿美元），RSD几乎为零，STRR≈0。即使调整参数（H=1080或V=$15），RSD仍接近零。学校预算明确核算教师和员工时间，但制度性要求学生的时间几乎没有直接财政对应物。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了一个中性、可复制的量化方法，用于测量K-12财政中成人劳动力核算与学生时间核算之间的差距。首次系统性地定义了学生时间财政不承认的概念和测量指标。
AI.practical_contributions: 为教育财政研究者提供了一种透明的分析工具，揭示了现行K-12财政体系中一个被忽视的维度，有助于促进对教育资源配置更全面的讨论。

detail.abstract: This paper develops a comprehensive empirical framework to examine whether financial machine learning (ML) and artificial intelligence (AI) generate economically meaningful and policy-relevant improvements in asset pricing, market efficiency, portfolio allocation, volatility forecasting, and market-stress prediction in India. The study is motivated by two converging forces: the accelerating deployment of AI across global capital markets and India's structural transformation into a deep, retail-intensive, and regulation-attentive equity market. India grew at 7.6 percent in FY26 and is projected to maintain 6.6 percent growth in FY27, while NSE investor accounts have crossed 25 crore with 12.7 crore unique registered investors as of January 2026, and SIP inflows reached a record ₹3.34 lakh crore in 2025. Against this backdrop, the paper proposes a multi-model empirical architecture that benchmarks CAPM, Fama-French, ARIMA, and GARCH against Random Forest, XGBoost, Support Vector Machines, LSTM, and transformer-based models across NSE and BSE data from 2010 to 2026. The design deploys rolling-window out-of-sample validation, SHAP-based explainability, panel regressions with firm and time fixed effects, and quantile-loss evaluation, enabling a joint assessment of statistical accuracy, economic usefulness, and policy relevance. The paper argues that AI delivers its largest gains where financial relationships are nonlinear, regimesensitive, and information-rich, but that those gains are conditional on data quality, model governance, and institutional capacity. The paper's contribution is to bridge financial economics, explainable AI, and emergingmarket institutional analysis in a single framework that is directly applicable to India's evolving market and regulatory architecture.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了一个综合实证框架，研究金融机器学习和人工智能在印度资本市场中是否在资产定价、市场效率、投资组合配置、波动率预测和市场压力预测等方面产生了具有经济意义和政策相关性的改进。
AI.research_question: 金融机器学习和人工智能是否能在印度资本市场中产生具有经济意义和政策相关性的改进？
AI.motivation: 两大驱动力：一是人工智能在全球资本市场的加速部署，二是印度正在转型为深厚、零售密集且监管关注的股票市场（NSE投资者账户超2.5亿，SIP资金流入创纪录）。
AI.theoretical_framework: 将金融经济学、可解释人工智能（XAI）和新兴市场制度分析整合在一个统一框架中。核心观点：AI在非线性、制度敏感和信息密集的金融关系中收益最大，但收益取决于数据质量、模型治理和制度能力。
AI.method: 多模型实证架构：将CAPM、Fama-French、ARIMA、GARCH等传统模型与随机森林、XGBoost、SVM、LSTM和Transformer模型进行对比。使用2010-2026年NSE和BSE数据，采用滚动窗口样本外验证、SHAP可解释性、面板回归（企业+时间固定效应）和分位数损失评估。
AI.findings: AI在非线性、制度敏感和信息密集的金融关系中能带来最大收益，但这些收益是有条件的，取决于数据质量、模型治理和制度能力。
AI.theory_contributions: 将金融经济学、可解释AI和新兴市场制度分析三者融合在一个可直接应用于印度市场和监管架构的单一框架中。
AI.practical_contributions: 为印度资本市场的监管机构和市场参与者提供了关于AI模型实际效用的系统性评估，有助于指导数据质量、模型治理和制度能力建设方面的决策。

title: Main Street in Wall Street
affiliations: University of California San Diego

detail.title: Main Street in Wall Street
detail.abstract: We provide new empirical evidence for how daily stock returns embed information about economic activity at high-frequency. We decompose returns into short-and long-run components, and consider a macro-finance model to characterize their relationship with the macroeconomy. Building on this structure, we develop a methodology that exploits stock return reactions to macroeconomic news to recover daily market-implied expectations of real economic activity. Our results show that daily stock returns contain far more information on the underlying real economy than previously recognized, and help to explain the apparent disconnect between Wall Street and Main Street.

AI.tldr: 本文利用高频股票收益分解为短长期成分，结合宏观金融模型，发现每日股票收益包含的实体经济信息远超先前认知，有助于解释华尔街与 Main Street 之间的脱节。
AI.research_question: 每日股票收益如何嵌入高频经济活动信息？
AI.motivation: 传统观点认为股票市场与实体经济存在脱节（Wall Street vs. Main Street），本文试图揭示股票收益中未被充分挖掘的实体经济信息。
AI.theoretical_framework: 宏观金融模型，股票收益的短长期成分分解。
AI.method: 将股票收益分解为短期和长期成分；构建宏观金融模型刻画其与宏观经济的关系；利用股票收益对宏观经济新闻的反应来恢复市场隐含的实体经济预期。
AI.findings: 每日股票收益包含的实体经济信息远超先前认知；有助于解释华尔街与 Main Street 之间的表观脱节。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出新的实证证据和方法论，证明高频股票收益中蕴含丰富的宏观经济信息，弥补了传统宏观金融理论对股票-实体经济关系的认识不足。
AI.practical_contributions: 为投资者和政策制定者提供了一种从每日股票收益中提取实体经济预期的高频工具，有助于更及时地监测经济状况。

title: Platform Thinking for Circular Construction: When Digital Matchmaking Becomes a Socio-Technical Coordination Infrastructure
affiliations: ETH Zurich, Agyre and ETH Zurich

detail.title: Platform Thinking for Circular Construction: When Digital Matchmaking Becomes a Socio-Technical Coordination Infrastructure
detail.abstract: Digital platforms are increasingly promoted as enablers of circular construction, yet their design is too often guided by transactional logics that overlook upstream coordination gaps in (de)construction decision-making. Despite growing interest in digital solutions, little is known about how platform thinking operates in hybrid, asset-heavy, and professionally fragmented settings where coordination depends on not only digital infrastructures but also human judgment, shared accountability, and evolving project constraints. This study investigates how (de)construction professionals interpret the relevance, design logic, and coordination potential of a conceptual digital matchmaking platform developed for early-stage selective deconstruction workflows. The study adopts an exploratory design science research approach and conducts guided walkthroughs and post-session surveys with auditors, project advisors, demolition contractors, and collectors. The findings show that practitioners value anticipation, transparency, and professional judgment under uncertainty, and favor non-deterministic, human-in-the-loop matching over algorithmic optimization. The study provides empirical grounding for a boundary condition of transactional platform logics: In asset-intensive and temporally fragmented environments, exchanges cannot be fully stabilized ex ante and therefore resist reduction to discrete optimization problems. Under these conditions, the platform is understood by practitioners less as a transactional pairing device than as a socio-technical coordination infrastructure in which matchmaking operates as an iterative process that supports the exploration and revision of multiple coordination pathways. Building on these findings, the study develops practitioner-informed design principles for coordination-oriented digital infrastructures and contributes to platform thinking in non-digital-native sectors.

AI.tldr: 本文研究了在建筑拆除情境中，专业从业者如何理解数字撮合平台的价值。研究发现，从业者更看重人工判断与非确定性匹配，而非算法优化。平台应被视为社会-技术协调基础设施，而非交易配对工具。
AI.research_question: （去）建筑专业人士如何理解面向早期选择性拆除工作流程的概念性数字撮合平台的相关性、设计逻辑及协调潜力？
AI.motivation: 数字平台被推广为循环建筑的支持工具，但其设计往往受交易逻辑主导，忽视了（去）建筑决策中上游协调的缺失。在混合型、资产密集且专业碎片化的环境中，协调不仅依赖数字基础设施，还依赖人类判断、共同责任和项目约束的动态变化，但目前对此知之甚少。
AI.theoretical_framework: 平台思维（Platform Thinking）、交易逻辑 vs. 协调导向的基础设施、社会-技术系统理论、边界条件理论
AI.method: 探索性设计科学研究方法，包括引导式走查和事后问卷调查，对象包括审计员、项目顾问、拆除承包商和回收商。
AI.findings: 1) 从业者重视不确定性下的预期、透明度和专业判断；2) 倾向于非确定性、人在回路中的匹配，而非算法优化；3) 在资产密集和时间碎片化环境中，交换无法事先完全稳定，因此抵抗被简化为离散优化问题；4) 平台被理解为社会-技术协调基础设施，匹配是迭代过程，支持探索和修正多种协调路径。
AI.theory_contributions: 1) 为交易性平台逻辑提供了经验性的边界条件证据；2) 提出平台应被视为协调基础设施而非交易配对设备；3) 丰富了非数字原生行业的平台思维理论。
AI.practical_contributions: 1) 提出了从业者参与设计的协调导向数字基础设施设计原则；2) 为循环建筑领域的数字平台设计提供了实践指导。

title: Model Claims: Native or Imported
affiliations: Independant

detail.title: Model Claims: Native or Imported
detail.abstract: A common failure in quantitative practice is not methodological error. The arithmetic is exact, the model is correctly specified, the code runs. The failure is epistemic misclassification: treating a claim imported into an analytical object as though the object had earned it natively. Breiman (2001) showed that statistical modeling operates under two cultures distinguished by how models are built. Shmueli (2010) showed that explanation and prediction are distinct goals that impose different requirements on model construction and evaluation. Neither addresses what a model is entitled to claim once built. That requires a third distinction: whether the entitlement a model carries is native, earned through the object's own design, or imported, carried in from outside and placed on the object's output. Imported entitlement may be legitimate. Epistemic misclassification occurs when imported entitlement is treated as native entitlement. The paper provides a diagnostic framework for distinguishing native from imported claims, grounds the framework in the philosophy of models and causal inference, distinguishes validation types, and shows that many replication failures are corrections of epistemic inflation rather than evidence of scientific fragility.

AI.tldr: 论文提出了一种新的诊断框架，区分分析对象中"原生"与"导入"的认识论主张，指出许多量化实践的失败并非方法错误，而是认识论误分类——将导入的主张误当作原生主张。这种错误导致"认识论通胀"，许多复制失败实则是通胀的修正而非科学脆弱性的证据。
AI.research_question: 如何区分分析对象中"原生"（通过自身设计获得）与"导入"（从外部携带进来）的认识论主张？认识论误分类如何导致量化实践的失败？
AI.motivation: 量化实践中大量失败并非方法错误（计算精确、模型正确、代码可运行），而是认识论层面的误分类。Breiman（2001）和Shmueli（2010）分别讨论了建模文化与解释/预测的区别，但均未涉及模型建成后有权主张什么。需要第三重区分来填补这一空白。
AI.theoretical_framework: 基于模型哲学和因果推断理论，区分"原生主张"（通过对象自身设计获得的权利）与"导入主张"（从外部携带并置于对象输出上的权利），并以此构建认识论误分类的诊断框架。
AI.method: 理论分析与概念辨析，提出诊断框架以区分原生与导入主张，并据此区分不同的验证类型。
AI.findings: 认识论误分类是量化实践失败的常见根源；许多所谓的"复制失败"实际上是认识论通胀的修正，而非科学脆弱性的证据；导入的主张可能是合法的，但被误当作原生主张时即构成认识论误分类。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出了"原生vs导入主张"这一第三重区分，弥补了Breiman（两种文化）和Shmueli（解释vs预测）的遗漏；将这一区分建立在模型哲学和因果推断理论基础上；重新解释了复制失败现象。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供诊断框架帮助研究者识别量化分析中的认识论误分类；区分验证类型以改善研究实践；纠正对复制危机的理解偏差。

detail.abstract: Agricultural productivity in Nigeria remains constrained by low mechanization and weak adoption of improved indigenous agricultural machinery, despite their potential to reduce production costs and improve farm output. This study develops a hybrid analytical framework that integrates econometric modeling, Structural Equation Modeling (SEM), and Machine Learning (ML) to examine the determinants of adoption and support the design of a scalable financing architecture for indigenous agricultural machinery among smallholder farmers. Data sourced from farm settlements in Batati, Kutigi, Wuya and Bida in Niger state, and were analyzed using robust OLS, SEM, and tree-based ML models (Random Forest and XGBoost), supported by diagnostic tests and post-estimation validation. Adoption is mainly driven by awareness, relative advantage, perceived usefulness, perceived ease of use, and farm size, while age, education, and experience are not significant. SEM confirms strong validity and good model fit, and econometric results support the key behavioral and economic effects. Machine learning shows moderate predictive accuracy, with XGBoost performing better than Random Forest, indicating nonlinear adoption patterns. Overall, the study shows that adoption is shaped by behavioral, economic, and institutional factors, and the integrated econometric-SEM-machine learning framework improves understanding and prediction of adoption behavior.

AI.tldr: 本研究构建了计量经济学、结构方程模型（SEM）与机器学习（ML）的混合分析框架，考察尼日利亚小农户采纳本土农业机械的决定因素。结果表明，采纳主要由认知度、相对优势、感知有用性、感知易用性和农场规模驱动，而年龄、教育、经验不显著。XGBoost优于随机森林，显示非线性采纳模式。
AI.research_question: 尼日利亚小农户采纳本土农业机械的决定因素是什么？如何设计可扩展的融资架构来支持这种采纳？
AI.motivation: 尼日利亚农业生产率受到低机械化和本土农业机械采纳不足的制约，尽管这些机械有潜力降低生产成本、提高农业产出。
AI.theoretical_framework: 整合了技术接受模型（感知有用性、感知易用性）、创新扩散理论（认知度、相对优势）以及行为经济学和制度经济学视角。
AI.method: 混合分析框架：稳健OLS计量回归、结构方程模型（SEM）、树基机器学习模型（随机森林和XGBoost），辅以诊断检验和事后效度验证。数据来自尼日尔州四个农业定居点的农户调查。
AI.findings: （1）采纳的主要驱动因素：认知度、相对优势、感知有用性、感知易用性和农场规模；（2）年龄、教育和经验不显著；（3）SEM确认良好的模型拟合和效度；（4）XGBoost预测性能优于随机森林，表明存在非线性采纳模式；（5）采纳行为受行为、经济和制度因素共同塑造。
AI.theory_contributions: 整合计量经济学、SEM与机器学习三种方法论，构建了改进采纳行为理解与预测能力的混合分析框架，克服了单一方法的局限性，并揭示出采纳行为的非线性特征。
AI.practical_contributions: 为设计针对本土农业机械的可扩展融资架构提供实证依据，帮助政策制定者和推广机构识别关键驱动因素（如认知度和感知有用性），从而更有效地推动小农户机械化采纳。

title: Settlement Ether and the Next Evolutionary Step in Cryptographically Stored Value

detail.title: Settlement Ether and the Next Evolutionary Step in Cryptographically Stored Value
detail.abstract: We introduce Settlement Ether, a third-generation blockchain architecture that emerges naturally from the technique of cryptographic ownership separation introduced in EU Patent Application No. XXX (2026) [42, 41], and demonstrated in production by the Lemnicoin (LEMNI) cryptocurrency on Polygon mainnet and by the proposed Bitcoin Tapscript extension. We position this work within an evolutionary trajectory of cryptocurrency: Bitcoin (Generation 1.0) demonstrated that value can be made cryptographic; Ethereum (Generation 2.0) demonstrated that cryptographic value can be made programmable; cryptographic ownership separation enables Generation 3.0, in which the chain itself need not be the source of ownership truth. We argue that this third evolutionary step is being compelled by the quantum computing threat: the conventional responsechain-level migration to post-quantum cryptographyinvolves coordination costs untenable within the timeline contemporary quantum-hardware projections demand, while cryptographic ownership separation provides post-quantum protection unilaterally, and, in doing so, reveals a deeper architectural inversion of which quantum resistance is only one consequence. We perform a layer-by-layer audit of the quantum vulnerability surface of contemporary blockchains and establish that the threat reduces, in practice, to a single cryptographic primitive: the signature scheme that authorizes value transfer. We then show that this single vulnerability can be remediated by separating the ownership-authorization signature from the networkvalidity signature, placing only the former on a quantum-resistant cryptographic basis. The consequences for blockchain architecture are profound: the chain becomes a pure settlement and ordering layer; state can be moved o-chain; block-based consensus becomes optional; throughput improves by orders of magnitude. We argue that the migration to Generation 3.0 does not require coordinated protocol changes at the chain level; it can proceed unilaterally, by users adopting the dual-authority output construction on any chain that supports Tapscript or equivalent programmable spending conditions.

AI.tldr: 本文提出了一种基于密码学所有权分离技术的第三代区块链架构——Settlement Ether，通过将所有权授权签名与网络有效性签名分离，实现量子抗性、链成为纯结算层、状态可移至链下、吞吐量大幅提升，且用户可单边升级无需全网协调。
AI.research_question: 如何通过密码学所有权分离技术，在无需全网协调的情况下解决区块链面临的量子计算威胁，并推动区块链架构向第三代演进？
AI.motivation: 量子计算威胁日益迫近，传统链级迁移至后量子密码学的方案协调成本过高、时间窗口不可行；需要一种可单边执行、无需共识协调的量子抗性解决方案。
AI.theoretical_framework: 密码学所有权分离（Cryptographic Ownership Separation）；区块链代际演化理论（比特币1.0：价值密码化 → 以太坊2.0：可编程价值 → 3.0：链非所有权真相来源）；量子脆弱面分层审计。
AI.method: 分层审计量子脆弱面（layer-by-layer audit）；形式化论证所有权分离的量子抗性；基于Tapscript的双授权输出（dual-authority output）原型实现与生产部署（Lemnicoin/Polygon主网、Bitcoin Tapscript扩展）。
AI.findings: （1）量子脆弱面在实践层面仅归约为单一原语——授权价值转移的签名方案；（2）所有权分离可将该脆弱面隔离并置于量子抗性密码学基础上；（3）后果：链成为纯结算排序层、状态可离链、区块共识可选、吞吐量提升数个数量级；（4）迁移可单边进行，无需链级协调协议变更。
AI.theory_contributions: 提出第三代区块链架构的理论基础——密码学所有权分离；重新定义了区块链的核心功能（从所有权真相来源降维为纯结算层）；揭示了量子抗性仅是这一架构反转的一个推论而非全部。
AI.practical_contributions: 提供了一条可立即执行的量子抗性升级路径（基于Tapscript的双授权输出构造）；已在Lemnicoin/Polygon主网和Bitcoin Tapscript扩展中生产验证；解决了量子威胁下全网协调升级的不可行性难题。
